speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, how many days ago did you give birth, and what is your current temperature?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have uterine tenderness and urinary frequency; do you have any foul-smelling vaginal discharge, and is the pain localized specifically to the lower abdomen? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any chills or rigors, and have you noticed any foul-smelling lochia? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge? REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound
Given the uterine tenderness, fever, and decrease in bowel sounds following a prolonged labor, I am concerned about endometritis or a pelvic infection. I need to rule out retained products of conception or an abscess.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal pelvic ultrasound effectively rules out retained products of conception or a pelvic abscess. Given the uterine tenderness, fever, and prolonged labor history, I am confident this is postpartum endometritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis
